source: AIA methodology: aia_inputs.mean_rating with survey weights 1 + (k mod 3), sociomap_3d.frame_fit, normalise_rel, terrain under its rule 'idw' (inverse-distance weighting, w_j = 1 / d_j^3, exact at each object; SCALE 27, SPAN 62, FILL 0.70, NG 84), unrated objects and the frame as in sociomap_3d.render: an object nobody rated is not placed (relative height null, no hill), the frame is fitted over the rated objects with a known pair (no fit when none); the positions from signed_off_layout.json; written by make_terrain_fixture.py <methodology dir> signed_off_layout.json signed_off_terrain.json; numpy 2.5.4
